desc: Parse H, W, the grid F, Q, and all queries, preserving 1-indexed coordinates.

Implement offline DSU with small-to-large query sets: sort cells descending by F, activate cells one by one, union with active neighbors, answering queries whose endpoints connect at the merge threshold.
Handle same-cell queries (u == v) separately by setting M = F_u and answering |Y-Z| immediately.
After processing all cells, compute the answer for each query as |Y-Z| + 2*max(0, min(Y,Z) - M) and output; sample tests passed.
